I don’t have that specific EP‑WAS table/value offline. If you share the results table or allow web access, I can pull the exact pooled β immediately. Otherwise, here’s quick R code to extract it if you have the EP‑WAS CSV:

- R (dplyr)
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(stringr)
  df <- read_csv("epwas_results.csv")  # replace with the EP‑WAS results file
  res <- df %>%
    filter(str_to_upper(exposure) == "LBXPFOA",
           str_to_upper(outcome)  == "LBXSUA",
           model %in% c(6, "6", "m6", "M6")) %>%
    select(exposure, outcome, model, beta = matches("beta|estimate")) %>%
    distinct()
  print(res)
